sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/24 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facilities 116 Iron Bow and 117 Atlatl, and search/details for each of their 46 RV-capable sites, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: reservevaparks.com site details (search/details per unit, read 2026-10-20): all 37 electric/water sites list 'Electricity Hookup (Amp): 30' and 'Water Hookup'; https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/occoneechee: 'Iron Bow Campground (Campground B) sites all have electric and water hookups. Atlatl Campground (Campground C) has both sites with electric and water hookups and sites without.'

values.note: 46 campsites: Iron Bow (B) 13 electric/water sites up to 35 ft; Atlatl (C) 33 sites up to 30 ft (24 electric/water, 9 without hookups; 12 of them waterview), plus 3 yurts and a camping lodge. One pull-through. A separate equestrian campground has 11 pull-through 50-amp horse sites. DCR's page also says 45 and 48 campsites in other paragraphs.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/occoneechee ('Total campsites: 46'; 'Iron Bow Campground (Campground B) sites allow equipment up to 35' long and Atlatl Campground (Campground C) sites allow equipment up to 30' long') + reservevaparks.com grid and site details, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Both campgrounds have bathhouses with hot showers and flush toilets. Firewood is sold at the office and near the camp host site (35).

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/occoneechee ('Both campgrounds have bathhouses with hot showers and flush toilets'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: First Friday in March through the first Monday in December.

season.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/occoneechee ('Camping is available from the first Friday in March until the first Monday of December'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'All sites are reserved by a specific site.' The booking site gives a 14-night maximum stay on each campsite. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.; campers go straight to their site, where the welcome packet is posted.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/occoneechee (Camping) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on Iron Bow and Atlatl sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed season (first Friday in March to first Monday in December, on the park's own page) and the booking site's prices matching the recorded fees ($27 no hookups, $37 electric/water, $32/$43 waterview; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12). Added 30-amp electric and water at sites, 46 campsites up to 35 ft (Iron Bow 35, Atlatl 30) with one pull-through, showers and flush toilets, reservable by specific site with a 14-night maximum. Not stated: sewer, dump station, booking window or cutoff for this park, first-come policy. Platform left inherited ('operator' in the state:VA row; the site runs on US eDirect).
